description: Search Edamam's recipe database by keyword with optional diet, health, and cuisine filters. Returns recipes with calories, time, servings, and ingredient lists. Example: search_recipes({ query: "chicken curry", health: "gluten-free", limit: 5 })

_apiKey.description: Optional Edamam credentials (comma-separated nutrition,recipe,food pairs of app_id:app_key). Omit to use the platform key.

query.description: Recipe search keywords, e.g. "chicken curry", "vegan brownies"

name: search_recipes
title: Search Recipes
